name: Segunda Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad (Resolución 44/2023)

description: Segunda Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad (Resolución 44/2023, September 4, 2023). National cybersecurity strategy of the Argentine Republic approved by the Chief of the Cabinet of Ministers, setting strategic lines for critical infrastructure protection, CERT.ar incident response, regulatory modernization, and federal cyber resilience.

relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Presidencia de la Nación Argentina — Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros (argentina.gob.ar).
